verdict.rationale: Appwrite documents a REST and GraphQL API with many SDKs, and a CLI that covers creating and managing projects, rows, files, users and Functions, plus 'other operations available through Appwrite's API'. Its official MCP server also lets agents operate on a project, so programmatic management is clearly broad. Nothing in the pack states that every Console action has an API equivalent, and several features (social providers, messaging topics) are described only as Console-tab workflows. Missing for 10: an explicit statement or evidence of full Console/API parity, API coverage of console-configured settings like auth providers and messaging topics, independent hands-on confirmation of parity.
